name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
instructions: Season chicken with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through. Remove.
In the same pan, saute garlic 1 minute. Add sun-dried tomatoes and cook 1 minute.
Pour in broth and cream. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in parmesan until melted. Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Return chicken to pan and coat in sauce. Simmer 3 minutes.
Serve over pasta, rice, or with crusty bread.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use coconut cream and nutritional yeast.
substitutions.gluten_free: Already gluten-free — serve with gluten-free pasta.
substitutions.low_carb: Serve over zucchini noodles or cauliflower rice.
